description:
Explore accounts, cards, and other banking solutions. Compare options and check features easily, without having to navigate between pages.

Ask, for example: "Explain the online account with no fees," "I need a card for traveling," or "What features does this product have?" You'll receive clear information without logging into your bank or sharing any personal data.

defaultPrompt: ¿Tenéis alguna cuenta sin comisiones que pueda contratar online? ¿Qué ventajas tiene?
